title: Static Elbowed-Antenna Nodal-Waist Ant
description: One newly authored complete stylised ant-like insect in a fixed walking-ground display. A broad distinct head narrows through a neck into a slimmer middle body; a genuinely narrow stalk with a raised petiole-like node then leads into a larger bulbous rear gaster. These body regions and both constrictions share one continuous closed skin. Six fine bent walking legs root only into the middle body; two visibly elbowed antennae, two small lateral eyes and paired short curved mandibular forms belong to the same whole. Not a spider with two legs removed, a shell-deleted beetle, a bead chain or an old body with a tail replaced. One whole prop, zero scenes. No exact species, caste, life scale, scientific anatomy, colony behaviour, biting, gait, rig, biological or ecological function claim.
